# Baremetrics

Baremetrics provides subscription analytics, metrics, customer insights, and revenue data for recurring-revenue businesses.

Category: Data. Connect from any WhatEverFi bot at https://whateverfi.com/integrations/baremetrics/.

## Actions

- **Get Account** (read-only): Return the connected Baremetrics account identity, company, default currency, and calculation range.
- **Get Cohorts** (read-only): Return Baremetrics cohort analysis for comparing customer retention and revenue behavior across signup cohorts.
- **Get Metric Breakdown** (read-only): Return daily values for one Baremetrics metric broken down by contributing customers or plans over an inclusive date range.
- **Get Metric Summary** (read-only): Return wide daily Baremetrics business metrics for an inclusive date range, including MRR, revenue, and customer counts in each daily row.
- **Get Metric Trend** (read-only): Return the daily time series and prior-period comparison for one Baremetrics metric over an inclusive date range.
- **Get Recurring Revenue Resource** (read-only): Get one customer, plan, subscription, charge, or refund by its OID within a Baremetrics source.
- **List Recurring Revenue Resources** (read-only): List one page of customers, plans, subscriptions, charges, or refunds from a Baremetrics source, using only filters valid for the selected…
- **List Sources** (read-only): List one page of payment and Baremetrics API sources in the connected account and return source IDs required by source-scoped resource…
